title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
notes: The book creates a sense of tension different from others, which makes it unique in many ways. In most books, the main villain or obstacle is singular or human. In The Martian, however, the problem acts as its antagonist, and the tension and pacing are based on solving that problem and adapting to new problems as they appear. The comedy is also genuinely good and uplifting for someone who could die at any moment. I read this book after watching the movie, and I will say some scenes are better in the movie, conveying emotion that just makes sense given all that is happening.
